overview: Many shoppers fill a cart and drift away. We build the reminders that bring them back politely. In your own email tool we set the trigger, the wait times, the cart contents shown in each message and the copy, then add an SMS step for people who opted in. We exclude anyone who has already bought and test with a real cart, so the flow is accurate before it goes live.

faq: How does the tool know a cart was abandoned?
Your store sends cart and checkout events to your email tool once the integration is on. We check that it records them correctly, and fix the connection if it does not.
Do I have to give a discount?
No. We can write the flow with a plain reminder first and put an incentive only in the last message, or leave it out. Discounts can train shoppers to wait, so we discuss it with you.
Can you also email people who did not give their email at checkout?
Only people who entered an address and agreed to hear from you. We cannot contact anonymous visitors, and we would not use methods that identify people without their consent.
Will I see how much money the flow brings back?
Your email tool reports revenue from each message. We explain where to find it, and the Premium package includes a short written guide on reading those numbers.
